comments.author: Visitor
comments.body: I am unable to share this quest with a member of my fleet, leading me to believe it has at least one discovery required before it can be accepted. Might anyone have some idea as to what the requirements are?

comments.author: boris
comments.body: Was it a chrono quest? If it was they can't be shared.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Boris: Actually, you can share any Chrono Quest with a fleetmate, unless they relate to the storyline chains involving St. Petersburg and Port Royal. Possibly Xanadu as well; I haven't gotten around to that chain yet. As an example, I shared the new Tiger adventure quest from Calicut with my fleetmates, and that was a Chrono Quest.

Visitor: My usual sources don't show this quest as having any requirements, but they may not be fully up to date. If I turn up anything else, I'll be sure to post about it.

comments.author: CaliCaddy
comments.body: Confirmed to have a pre-quest, added to the description.
